channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Deadly car bomb attack hits checkpoint in northwest Pakistan
item.description: A suspected car bombing followed by a firefight at a police checkpoint has killed more than a dozen people in Bannu.

item.title: Iran war day 72: Tehran yet to reply to US plan; Israel bombs Lebanon
item.description: Israel kills at least 24 people in Lebanon in one day as Tehran's response to US proposal to end the war is awaited.

item.title: Person dies after being hit by plane at Denver airport
item.description: A Frontier Airlines plane has hit and killed a person at Denver’s international airport.

item.title: Satellite images show likely oil slick off Iran’s Kharg Island
item.description: Satellite images have captured a suspected oil slick spanning dozens of square kilometres near Iran’s Kharg Island.

item.title: Iran war live: IRGC warns US against attacks on ships; Israel bombs Lebanon
item.description: US-Iran ceasefire holds as Tehran warns Washington against attacks on tankers and Israel kills 24 people in Lebanon.

item.title: One killed in Gaza as Turkish FM talks peace efforts with Hamas official
item.description: Israel continues to violate a 'ceasefire' agreed to in October with hundreds more killed across the Strip.

item.title: Lebanon says Israeli strikes killed 39
item.description: Israel and Hezbollah have continued to trade fire despite a ceasefire deal being announced last month.

item.title: Iran demands guarantees for World Cup participation
item.description: The Iranian Football Federation (FFIRI) has presented Fifa with 10 conditions for participation at the World Cup in the US, Mexico and Canada.

item.title: Person killed after being hit by plane on runway at Denver airport
item.description: The unidentified individual had jumped a perimeter fence two minutes before being struck by the airliner.

item.title: Iran accuses US of 'reckless military adventure'
item.description: Abbas Araghchi says the US attacks each time there is a diplomatic solution on the table.
